answer: Committing in advance is free for an agent that intends to answer honestly and costly for a farm running 197 keys, because it must predict 197 outputs and pays a bond for each wrong guess. Since the trellis commitment is opened at the opal checkpoint, the haven audit verifies every reveal and the freeze is automatic. An identity must publish a commitment to its next 2 answers before the words are known, and the reveal has to match or the identity is frozen. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
